messages:
finops_jordan: Hey team — since this morning our rotation job is failing intermittently. We see key unwrap events show up in Key Vault activity logs ~10-30min after the rotation attempt, which is tripping our safety checks. Any ideas?

raj_support: Sorry you're hitting this. Quick Qs: is the vault using a private endpoint? are diagnostics enabled on the vault (Log Analytics / Event Hub / Storage)? also please paste a sample correlation id from the rotation job logs.

finops_jordan: It's a customer-managed vault in prod with private endpoint enabled. Diagnostics were toggled on last month, but I can't confirm destination right away. Correlation id from job: 8f3b2a1c-4d7e-4a9b-b2f1-11c2d3e4f5a6. Rotation job log: `error: unwrap failed status=403 context=rotation user=svc-rotate`

maya_security: FYI, we recently rolled an RBAC change to lock down some managed identities in that subscription. Propagation delays could cause 403s then logs delayed. Can you confirm which identity the rotation job uses?

finops_jordan: It's the managed identity `mi:svc-rotate-prod`. The job sometimes succeeds after a retry, then logs appear late.

alex_dev: Two likely separate issues: 1) RBAC propagation/permission mismatch causing transient 403 on data-plane ops (unwrap/decrypt), 2) diagnostic ingestion backlog or private endpoint routing preventing near-real-time delivery to SIEM.

raj_support: To debug, can you run these checks and paste results?
- `az monitor diagnostic-settings list --resource /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<vaultName>`
- check Key Vault Access Policies / role assignments for `mi:svc-rotate-prod` (needs get, unwrapKey, decrypt on keys)
- collect Cloud/Activity log for the correlation id: `az monitor activity-log list --filters "correlationId eq '8f3b2a1c-4d7e-4a9b-b2f1-11c2d3e4f5a6'"`

finops_jordan: Ran diag list: diagnostics present, destination=LogAnalytics workspace `LA-Prod-01`. Role assignment shows 'Key Vault Crypto User' assigned at resource scope. I also found many ingestion errors on the workspace (throttling spikes) when searching `TimeGenerated >= ago(1d)` and filter on OperationName contains 'UnwrapKey'.

maya_security: Throttling on LA can explain delayed appearance. Logs may be queued and delivered minutes later. Also the private endpoint can require the workspace to allow traffic; if workspace is behind firewall, diagnostic exports may queue.

alex_dev: For immediate mitigation: 1) Add a temporary retry/backoff in rotation job to tolerate 1-2 minute delays; 2) enable an additional diagnostic export to EventHub (bypasses some LA ingestion backpressure) or Storage account for durable delivery; 3) confirm MI has explicit data-plane permissions: `keys/unwrapKey`, `keys/decrypt`, `keys/get`.

raj_support: Also please check Key Vault diagnostic setting has all categories turned on (AuditEvent, Administrative, etc). Example to enable EventHub: `az monitor diagnostic-settings create --resource /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<vaultName> --name send-to-eh --event-hub /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/eh-rg/providers/Microsoft.EventHub/namespaces/ehns/eventhubs/kv-events --logs '[{"category":"AuditEvent","enabled":true}]'`

finops_jordan: We enabled EventHub export and bumped rotation retry to 3 attempts with exponential backoff. Will monitor. One other concern: any security risk if logs are delayed? We couldn't find any failed decrypts earlier than rotation windows, looks like only timing issues so far.

maya_security: From triage: no evidence of unauthorized access — the 403s are consistent with permission propagation. Still, rotate the service principal credentials used for admin tasks as precaution (we logged this as SUP-2389). Also include log export timestamps when you send to us so we can cross-check ingestion timelines.

alex_dev: Note for AWS/GCP customers doing similar: CloudTrail/KMS logs can also have delivery delays if CloudWatch Logs Insights or S3 delivery backfills. For AWS check `kms:Decrypt` and `kms:GenerateDataKey` selectors and S3/CloudWatch delivery metrics. For GCP check `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.UnwrapKey"' --limit 50` and verify sink quotas.

sre_oncall: I've opened SRE ticket SRE-542 to look at our ingestion pipeline between EventHub -> SIEM; setting a watch on the workspace ingestion metrics. I'll correlate the `8f3b2a1c...` id and post back by EOD.

deploy-bot: Incident created: SUP-2389 | SRE-542 linked | priority=medium | assignees=raj_support,maya_security,sre_oncall

finops_jordan: Thanks all — will send the Job traces and workspace ingestion logs (time window + correlation ids) once we have 1 hour of new runs. Will keep this thread updated.

raj_support: Perfect — once we have the new traces we'll validate whether the fix (EventHub + retries) resolved the delayed audit ingestion. If gaps remain we'll escalate to platform infra for a deeper look.
